title: IPIP official public-domain statement
evidence_note: Instrument steward; reuse permission for IPIP items and scales.

title: IPIP-NEO-120 official items and keys
evidence_note: Existing instrument source identified in the supplied packet.

title: McCrae & Costa (1989), Reinterpreting the MBTI from the perspective of the five-factor model
evidence_note: Primary comparative research; overlap does not establish distinct categories or an individual conversion.

title: The Myers-Briggs Company: MBTI Facts
evidence_note: Publisher evidence: seven-study/sample table, older MBTI/NEO forms, correlations corrected for unreliability using manual coefficients; not observed prediction accuracy.

title: Myers & Briggs Foundation: The Preferences
evidence_note: Official construct descriptions; no protected questionnaire items reproduced.

title: The Myers-Briggs Company: MBTI Global Version
evidence_note: Global Step I has 92 items; Step II has 143. Version-specific counts.

title: The Myers-Briggs Company: Facts and Common Criticisms
evidence_note: Publisher reports Global Step I scale test-retest correlations of .81-.86 at 6-15 weeks.

title: The Myers-Briggs Company: Copyright and Permissions
evidence_note: Publisher restrictions on reproducing protected material in websites, software, and databases.

title: Open-Source Psychometrics Project: OJTS 2.1
evidence_note: 48-item online version; expressly developed against internet users who already identify with a type.

title: Open-Source Psychometrics Project: development and license
evidence_note: Self-identified-type item selection; posted CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. No item bank copied into this kit.

title: 16Personalities: Our Framework
evidence_note: Provider describes NERIS as reworked Big Five, rather than Jungian cognitive-function measurement.

title: Insights Discovery: validating the system factsheet
evidence_note: Provider methods, 25 frames/100 word pairs, alpha and retest summaries.

title: Insights: Discovery model developer documentation
evidence_note: Official model description and API contact; does not grant questionnaire reuse rights.

title: True Colors: four common personality types
evidence_note: Orange, Gold, Green, Blue; different meanings from Insights.

title: True Colors: Research Precis
evidence_note: Provider describes ipsative instrument and commissioned assessment review.

title: ASI: True Colors construct-validity report, 2021
evidence_note: Provider-hosted third-party report; interpretation must account for fixed-sum dependencies.

title: Everything DiSC: The Science Behind Everything DiSC
evidence_note: Provider scale reliability tables; relates to this instrument, not every DISC-branded test.

title: Color Code: About
evidence_note: Provider theory of power, intimacy, peace and fun motives.

title: Color Code: History of Personality Theory and Assessment
evidence_note: Provider theory document; does not validate conversion from this questionnaire.

title: Markey & Markey (2009), A brief assessment of the interpersonal circumplex
evidence_note: Primary research on the 32-item IPIP-IPC, across three studies.

title: IPIP-IPC official scoring key
evidence_note: Public-domain 32-item key, all positive within each octant.

title: IPIP-IPC official administration form
evidence_note: Public-domain wording and original administration instructions.

title: Boateng et al. (2018), Best practices for developing and validating scales
evidence_note: Methodological guidance, not evidence for the candidate questions in this kit.

title: Clark & Watson (2019), Constructing validity
evidence_note: Construct clarity, inclusive pools, related-construct testing, and dimensionality.

title: McNeish (2018), Thanks coefficient alpha, we will take it from here
evidence_note: Reliability estimators and limitations of relying on alpha alone.

title: Flake & Fried (2020), Measurement Schmeasurement
evidence_note: Transparent measurement decisions and avoidance of unreported scoring flexibility.

title: IPIP administration guidance
evidence_note: Permits mixing IPIP items; permission is separate from validating a new form.
